name: Response Parser
description: Parses a raw LLM response and extracts structured data: tool calls, step-complete signals, text, or retry indicators.

inputs.name: Raw Response
inputs.description: The raw text content from the LLM response

outputs.name: Response Type
outputs.description: One of: tool-call, step-complete, text, retry

outputs.name: Tool Arguments
outputs.description: JSON string of tool arguments (when type=tool-call or step-complete)

outputs.name: Text Content
outputs.description: The text content (when type=text or step-complete summary)

outputs.name: Extracted JSON
outputs.description: The raw extracted JSON string from the response

outputs.name: Has Multiple Tool Calls
outputs.description: Whether the response contained multiple tool calls (only first is returned)

outputs.name: Extra Tool Call Count
outputs.description: Number of additional tool calls found after the first (dropped)
